description: This file defines the AdoNetClusteringTable class, which implements IMembershipTable for managing cluster membership data in Orleans using ADO.NET. It includes methods for initializing, reading, inserting, updating, and deleting membership entries, along with detailed logging.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringTable
classes.description: Implements IMembershipTable for Orleans clustering using ADO.NET, providing methods for managing cluster membership data with detailed logging.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, creating database queries and optionally inserting the initial version row.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific membership row identified by a SiloAddress key.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry with a specified table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry with a new etag and table version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a membership entry.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes defunct silo entries older than a specified date.

methods.name: InitTableAsync
methods.description: Initializes the membership version row in the database.
